svg.title: Coordinate translation and output layouts, narrow layout
svg.desc: The same worked row as the wide figure, transposed: each input column j is a table row. Columns 0, 2 and 5 survive: t = 8, 130, 262 map to local positions 4, 65, 131, page-offset pairs (0, 4), (1, 1), (2, 3), physical pages 11, 2, 7 and physical slots 708, 129, 451. The equations and both output layouts follow.
